name: Winter Soldier

abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Incinerate: Zamanla enerji tabanlı yakma hasarı verir ve zırhı yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.

howToPlay: Winter Soldier için oynanış rehberi: Özel saldırılarını kullanarak rakiplerini alt edin. Komboları düzgün zamanlayarak siper alın.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Skill sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.
signatureAbility:
Emp Upgrade
An upgrade to Bucky's bionic arm grants his Critical Hits a 15% chance to Power Drain his target for [13 - 28]% of the target's max power. The amount drained increases based on Critical Hit Damage.

abilitySections.title: All Attacks
content: 11% chance to gain a Fury Buff for 7 seconds, granting +[1,963.5] Attack.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: Winter Soldier begins the fight with one type of Ammo loaded into all his guns. Each time he launches a Special Attack he automatically switches to the next Ammo Type. Winter Soldier can also Dash back and hold Block for 1.5 seconds to manually switch ammo types.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: Armor Piercing: Winter Soldier ignores all of the opponent's Armor and Resistance Ratings.
Incendiary: Winter Soldier Incinerates the opponent, dealing [3,730.65] Energy Damage over 6.5 seconds. This also removes Perfect Block Chance and reduces Block Proficiency by 50%.
Hollow Point: Any Bleed effect triggered during the attack has its Duration increased by 50%.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: 55% chance to inflict Bleed, dealing [3,730.65] Direct Damage over 4 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: 85% chance to inflict a Bleed Debuff, dealing [4,516.05] Direct Damage over 4 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: 100% chance to inflict a Bleed Debuff, dealing [9,032.1] Direct Damage over 3.5 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Emp Upgrade
content: An upgrade to Bucky's bionic arm grants his Critical Hits a 15% chance to Power Drain his target for [13 - 28]% of the target's max power. The amount drained increases based on Critical Hit Damage.
